detailed_description: The Regex Patterns Library shows a small set of common browser-side regular expression examples. The available patterns include email, HTTP/HTTPS URL, phone number, IPv4 address, hex color, and UUID. You can click Try It to load a pattern with its example text, edit the test input, see a simple match or no-match result from JavaScript RegExp.test, close the tester, or copy a raw pattern. It does not provide search, categories, PCRE guarantees, RFC-complete validation, capture group inspection, match highlighting, regex flags, performance profiling, language-specific code generation, or export options.
usage_steps: Choose one of the built-in patterns from the list.
Click Try It to open the simple tester with example input.
Edit the test input and review whether the JavaScript regex matches.
Copy the raw pattern when it is useful as a starting point.
Close the tester or try another built-in pattern.
usage_examples: Copy a simple email regex as a starter for a prototype form.
Test whether a sample string matches the built-in URL or phone pattern.
Compare a hex color or UUID value against the included example pattern.
Use the match result as a quick browser-side sanity check before manual review.
